entities.summary: George Henry Robert Charles William Vane-Tempest, 5th Marquess of Londonderry, styled Viscount Seaham between 1823 and 1854 and known as The Earl Vane between 1854 and 1872, was a British aristocrat, businessman, diplomat and Conservative politician.
